title: The first etale cohomology of a finite constant group on a closed subscheme of a normal affine scheme with separably closed function field vanishes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a normal integral affine scheme X with separably closed function field and a closed subscheme Z, the first etale cohomology of Z with coefficients in a finite abelian group vanishes (statement lines 14424-14429). The proof (proof lines 14431-14442) translates the class into a torsor, represents it by a finite etale scheme and uses the existence of a section of that cover to trivialize the torsor. H2: a three-step translation with three inputs, written out in full.
